newsitem.title: UK: Mexico cuts April Maya to Europe, unchanged to U.S.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cuts April Maya to Europe, unchanged to U.S.

text.p: Mexico has cut price formulas for its Maya and Isthmus crudes to Europe by 15 and 10 cents a barrel respectively in April, traders said on Friday.
State oil company Pemex also reduced the price of its Isthmus and Olmeca crudes for customers in the U.S. by 20 and 25 cents respectively, but left the U.S. Maya formula unchanged, they said.

Maya crude to Europe in April has been set at a discount of $2.00 a barrel to the Pemex price formula, down 15 cents from March, while Isthmus to Europe has been set 10 cents weaker at formula less 36 cents.

For customers in the Americas, Maya crude will be unchanged in April at formula less $1.75 a barrel, but Isthmus will drop 20 cents to formula less $1.35 a barrel and Olmeca 25 cents to formula plus 15 cents.
Traders said the reduction in the Maya price to Europe reflected stiff competition for market share from Iraqi and Russian sour crudes.
Pemex was also trying to find additional customers in Europe as production rises, they said.
"They are trying to allocate more volumes in Europe, Asia and the U.S. It's something they have to do," said one.
